recomputed:
I verified all 147 SOURCES.tsv entries (439,899,404 bytes) by SHA-256 and size and checked their decoded contents. I also verified the 184 ARTIFACTS.tsv and 13 local_inputs.tsv entries. The Drive HTML contains the author folders and CSV file ID. The separately downloaded CSV matched SHA-256 022cdf99360b2b9b98fd7ae04d44ccf28a25e6028b87d8439a0eaf25795f6ed8. The published and preprint supplements contain figures and ANOVA tables. The author repository reads the CSV and applies adjP < 0.05. The manuscript identifies the SST Flow-Seq experiment and reports female-higher Esr1, consistent with the CSV log2FC of +1.240360837. The series SOFT, publication XML and two patch comparisons also matched independent downloads. A new ENA response contained the same 16 data rows in a different order.

GEO, the registered sheet and ENA agree on GSM7018347–GSM7018354, four female and four male mice, one BioSample and experiment per GSM, two single-end runs per experiment. Each of the eight GEO archive members passed its own digest check and yielded 236,978 Kallisto rows, comprising two blocks with identical ordered IDs and lengths. All 118,489 versioned targets match the release-96 cDNA FASTA in order and length. Release 97 maps 118,333 canonical targets. Its deposited-target map lacks 87 author genes and its conditional mean reconstruction has 82 genes outside [1/1.1, 1.1].

I independently joined the full-precision edgeR DE table to single-feature author IDs and negated author log2FC for male minus female. The edgeR BH family has 15,386 tested rows, including 276 without published symbols. Of 15,110 published symbols and 24,909 author IDs, 15,075 pair exactly (99.7684% and 60.5203%). There are 34 pooled symbols and one single-ID miss, H2bc24. Pearson is 0.8734725967, Spearman 0.8926126335, and 13,215 of 15,075 nonzero pairs agree (87.6617%). Median absolute log2FC difference is 0.0860348227. Neither v2 route passes. The rounded public bundle gives 13,214 of 15,074 after Washc3 rounds to zero.

At adjusted P < 0.05 the author CSV yields 505 positive IDs (251 female-higher, 254 male-higher) and registered edgeR yields 25. All 25 have finite author FDR. There are 23 common calls, with whole-list Jaccard 23/507 = 0.04536489. On 14,335 jointly finite pairs the counts are 499, 25 and 23, with Jaccard 23/501 = 0.04590818. Of the matched rows, 740 lack author FDR and 35 also lack author raw P. The six unpaired author positives are Nupl1, Palm2, Lilrb4a, Gm6545, E2f2 and Il1rl2. Gpcpd1 and Pcx reverse direction among the paired author positives. Conditional BH on the 14,478 CSV rows with finite FDR recovers exactly 505 positives from either the printed raw P or the two-sided Wald P. The latter gives AC149222.1 an FDR of 0.05000574889.

I reran the reference and mean calculations for the six Ensembl core releases. Missing/extra positive IDs relative to the export were 1/2, 0/0, 1/0, 1/0, 3/0 and 77/119 for releases 103–108 respectively. Release 104 assigns 116,362 targets. The preliminary Python import has zero means outside the earlier ratio interval and 24,908 within printed precision. The Galaxy wrapper source enables the beta prior and passes no alpha to results(). Historical DESeq2 defaults to alpha 0.1 for filter optimization and BH for adjustment. Each package patch diff changes only DESCRIPTION.

I rebuilt the isolated R 3.5.3 runtime and reran tximport 1.10.1 and DESeq2 1.22.2 from the raw archive and release-104 assignments. The complete decompressed output table was byte-identical to the retained replay. It contained 35,939 fitted genes, 24,909 positive means and the same 505 positive IDs and signs as the CSV. All 24,909 means met a strict half-last-printed-digit bound without numerical slack. Replay FDRs were 0.03601384 (Elk3), 0.02135045 (Mical3), 0.01989595 (Moxd1), 0.03291382 (Il1rl2) and 0.05001824 (AC149222.1). Cd22 lacks replay raw P and FDR. Gm3298 and Gm10045 lack author raw P and have finite replay raw P. Across jointly finite FDRs the maximum absolute difference was 0.178462. The observed positive-mean IDs and means helped identify the candidate annotation. The native fit admitted all mapped genes without filtering to the CSV or its FDR family, and the decision threshold stayed at 0.05.

The registry specifies sst_neurons/male_vs_female. The five current ledgers include manual, verification and comparability records and no dataset-specific additional spec or concordance review. The proposed enum values occur in the ledgers. Closure as compared, a limited assessment and an empty sign-off list are justified.
problems: The phrase “full-input” obscures the mapping loss. Release 104 leaves 2,127 of 118,489 unique deposited targets unassigned, carrying 0.6603% of estimated-count mass. All mapped genes entered the native fit. Release 104 was singled out by comparison to the author export, so the replay supports that candidate without demonstrating which annotation file the authors used. The 82-gene discrepancy refers to the older ratio band. Printed-precision recovery of every mean requires the native import.

The all-nonzero sign count applies to the full-precision registered DE table. The public bundle rounds the Washc3 coefficient from −0.0000089839 to zero. The corrected proposal names the representation used for v2 and distinguishes its 15,110 published rows from the 15,386-row BH family.

The 505 calls are computed from the author CSV under the rule in the authors’ downstream code. The paper reports individual results and does not state a total of 505 in its body. I also limited the Galaxy settings claim to the archived wrapper and the replay. The original job settings and annotation checksum are still unknown.
ENA records two runs per biological sample. The abundance tables contain two unlabeled blocks, so they support the per-GSM aggregation without identifying a particular SRR for each block.

Two software manifest descriptions need qualification. The 20-byte annotation-PACKAGES.gz is a complete gzip stream with an empty payload, confirmed by a fresh download. GenomeInfoDbData_1.2.0.tar.gz is a source package despite its generic binary-package note. It installed from source during the successful replay.
